title: Super Nintendo
description: A cartridge image (LoROM or HiROM by its internal header): a copier header (if any) as data, then each bank one ca65 segment linked at the address the code runs at, the internal header written as its fields; flow follows the register widths and the emulation flag (console_snes.cpp). The chips' registers by their hardware names, the direct page as dp_nn; an ld65 configuration lays the segments out in file order.

machine.toolchain: CodeBreaker's own assembler (ca65 syntax), or cc65 (ca65 and ld65)
